analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 개선세 유지
analysis.reason:

MACD 히스토그램은 -6.3017에서 0.6602로 개선되며 바닥 다지기 신호.

analysis.reasonEn:
RSI rose from 36.3 to 45.4, confirming exit from oversold territory.
MACD histogram improved from -6.3017 to 0.6602, signaling bottoming.
5-day low of $380.33 is higher than 20-day low of $351.19, forming a Higher Low pattern.
Volume at 0.60 of 5-day average is subdued, limiting directional confirmation.
